answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, unlocked only after continuous uptime. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the oasis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the cedar of the next round. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The copper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
